title: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin
description: A flavorful and moist pork tenderloin dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of garlic, herbs, and a hint of salt elevates the natural tenderness of the pork.
instructions: Season the pork tenderloin with salt, Algerian seasoning, and minced garlic.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork tenderloin for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
